source: Bendix AM-68-1 Vol. I, Section II (PDF 26 to 138) plus Table 1-1 (PDF 20)
method: two independent inventories from the page images (Claude, Codex gpt-6-astra high), exact-match diff (tools/diff_tables.py), vocabulary rules and a resolutions file (qa/inventory-s2-b1/resolutions.csv) applied by tools/build_figures.py
scope_rule: in_scope: the item carries numbers to extract into data/ (yes | maybe | no). transcribe: the page is transcribed in phase b (yes for all of Section II).
priority_rule: 1: needed for the first calibration and prediction protocols (shear family, LPT records with known bed state, DPT signatures and correlation, materials tables). 2: needed to set up or interpret those tests (bed preparation, boundary and bin effects, rate series, degradation). 3: context only.
mcc_rule: mcc_relevant yes only for figures showing the same material after different loading or handling histories with a different response, plus the state maps needed to read them; maybe for the direct shear dilation panel.
curve_count_convention: every drawn line is a trace, including each boundary of a shaded or bracketed range; markers and the fitted line through them are one response series; construction guides are not counted.

resolution_notes.rotation: Page re-read (PDF 20): table printed sideways. Claude had not inspected the page. Credit Codex.
resolution_notes.priority: Protocol rule: duplicate of Table 2-3; Table 2-3 is canonical.

resolution_notes.in_scope: Narrow scope rule: table of numbers (target property ranges). Claude's reading kept.
resolution_notes.priority: Protocol rule: lunar estimates are context for soil selection.

resolution_notes.in_scope: Narrow scope rule keeps Claude's maybe; settle when the materials crosswalk is extended.

resolution_notes.data_form: Flow chart drawn as boxes and arrows; a diagram rather than running text.

resolution_notes.in_scope: Narrow scope rule: conceptual chart; transcribed with the page.

resolution_notes.priority: Protocol rule: photo without setup numbers.
Protocol rule: a worked sieve sheet for one bed supports interpretation of the degradation figures; not a calibration input.

resolution_notes.data_form: One drawn conversion line (curves = 1 agreed); curve is consistent with the count.
resolution_notes.in_scope: Narrow scope rule keeps Claude's maybe: nomograph with a hypothetical soil.

resolution_notes.priority: Protocol rule: state-to-unit-weight map needed to interpret beds; derivable from min and max density.

resolution_notes.test_type: Density against compaction duration describes bed preparation.

resolution_notes.in_scope: Narrow scope rule: photo. Codex's finer test_type label kept so a search for direct shear finds it.

resolution_notes.mcc_relevant: Narrow MCC rule with the dilation panel as maybe: dilatancy is state dependent but may be covered by mu(I) with a dilatancy term.
resolution_notes.y_unit: Two panels: shear stress in psf above and normal displacement in thousandths of an inch below (printed multiplier x 10^3). Codex recorded the upper panel only.

resolution_notes.mcc_relevant: Narrow MCC rule; Codex's own note says density dependence does not identify history dependence.

resolution_notes.in_scope: Narrow scope rule: hypothetical envelopes without ticks.
Narrow scope rule keeps maybe: classical factors reproducible from formulas.

resolution_notes.data_form: Recorded traces with an author fit: data_form stays curve; trace_classes carries the mixture.

resolution_notes.priority: Protocol rule: bin-size comparison supports interpretation (boundary effects).

resolution_notes.curves: Claude 10 (about ten) against Codex 11 at 300 dpi; two curves labeled only Dr approx 0.96. Count again at 600 dpi during extraction.
resolution_notes.priority: Protocol rule: size and bin effects.
Protocol rule: rate series are interpretation (rate insensitivity) unless the extended rate protocol is run.
Protocol rule: bin size sets the simulation domain; not a calibration input.

resolution_notes.curves: Page re-read (PDF 110): nine labeled curves plus one unlabeled line ending near Df/D 0.95 at ordinate 270. Credit Codex. Identity of the unlabeled line open.

resolution_notes.priority: Protocol rule: every Gp printed on an LPT figure is read through the DPT correlations.
Protocol rule: DPT geometry is the setup of a prediction target.

resolution_notes.curves: Each drawn line is a trace: two used-soil curves plus the two boundaries of the unused range. Credit Codex for the convention.

resolution_notes.in_scope: Narrow scope rule: photo of the density scoop.
Narrow scope rule: photo; the parts list on printed 2-107 is transcribed with the page.
Narrow scope rule; roller passes per soil are transcribed with printed 2-110 and 2-113.
